fact: The state-owned enterprise FaydaVerse, under Ethiopian Investment Holdings, runs the national digital ID system and bills banks for record retrievals and authentications.

The National ID program (Fayda) has become the state-owned enterprise Faydaverse under Ethiopian Investment Holdings and runs the ID, wallet and credential verification, per its stakeholder engagement director.

Faydaverse, the former National ID Program, was inaugurated as a state-owned enterprise under Ethiopian Investment Holdings with a mandate to develop, operate and scale digital public infrastructure, and operates the national digital ID system.

Biometric Update says Ethiopia's National ID Program, re-established in August as the public entity Faydaverse Digital Solutions, runs the Fayda Partner Portal sandbox and the VeriFayda authentication platform.
The national ID authority became the government-owned enterprise Faydaverse in August 2026, mandated to develop, operate and scale the digital public infrastructure.
National ID Ethiopia's deck says the Program Office and the planned Fayda state enterprise will operate in parallel to ensure operational continuity, with home-grown capacity.
